title: Shizuka Sacrifices Herself to a Giant Dog — Part 3

series.summary: Tiny Shizuka faces down a hound the size of a horse and offers herself as the sacrifice, then beats the beast by drinking Kusuri's sleeping potion herself.

segments.voiceover_text: The team swears to take this seriously — tonight they save Hakari's light. Nano remembers her flustered and kind at the waterpark. That is who is waiting for them.

Then the mansion's real guard appears: a hound the size of a horse, towering over tiny Shizuka. She is terrified. Still, she bows flat and offers herself as the sacrifice, tears shining. The beast leans down toward her — gently.

But the dog corners her again — no way out. So Shizuka pulls Kusuri's sleeping potion from her collar and drinks it herself. She drifts off smiling. And the worst trap still waits ahead, made of light.
